verdict.rationale: Canva's own Connect/REST APIs let a programmatic client run design work without the editor UI: autofilling Brand Templates, bulk generation, resizing, and syncing designs and assets. That is the product's own headless automation surface. However, nothing documents running in CI, non-interactive or service-account auth, or a CLI for executing design jobs; the CLI shown is only for creating and managing Canva apps. Missing for 10: explicit headless/CI execution guidance, non-interactive authentication for pipelines, a CLI or runner for design automation, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Canva REST APIs let you integrate Canva's capabilities into your own web apps and platforms.
You can use the REST APIs to build web apps that create and sync assets, designs, comments, and more.
Automatically personalize and populate Brand Templates with real-time content from your data sources.
Automatically create resized versions of designs in new dimensions, formats, or aspect ratios.
Scale design output - generate personalized content in bulk using your own data and visuals.
